TgJelly 1.0

The first stable release: Telegram notifications for Jellyfin, from a bot that runs inside your server and is set up from the dashboard or the bot itself.

One build now works on both Jellyfin 10.11 and Jellyfin 12. There is one download per release, and versions follow the release number: this one is 1.0.0.0.

Also in this release:
- The "wrong build for this server" check is gone, along with its banner and status lines, because there is no wrong build any more.
- The version label in the dashboard header shows v1.0 and links to this release.

name: TgJelly
description: A Telegram bot inside your Jellyfin server: new media, security and server notifications for the chats, groups and channels you choose, set up from the dashboard or the bot.
